title: Leftover summoned minions yank the music back to combat right after a boss falls (cuts the 2 s wind-down, sting lands over combat music)
repro: Fight a summoner boss (commander, president, marsh_witch, golem_king, ruin_warden, finargle_elder...) and kill it while its minions (meta minion, Enemy._summon) are still alive. boss_ended() sets tier 0 and starts the area song with a 2 s fade; minions are not killed with the boss, so the next checks see engaged foes and climb to combat_light/danger after ~0.25-0.5 s (FADE_IN 0.6), then j_victory fires at 2 s over the combat track. PROBE (tools/probe_c6_08_dm.gd, penguin meadow, commander + 2 summoned soldiers): 0.25 s after the boss died tier 0 'meadow'; 0.5 s after, tier 3 combat_elite (summoned minions count as elite) and it stayed; sting fired at 2 s over combat_elite.
fix: After boss_ended, hold DangerMusic at tier 0 for BOSS_WIND + sting length (a _post_boss timer that assess/tick respects), and/or ignore meta 'minion' foes whose summoner is dead; or have Enemy._die on a summoner scatter/poof its minions like decoys.

title: Post-boss victory sting and boss_ended are frozen during dialogue, so boss music plays under the after-fight talk and j_victory fires out of context after it closes
repro: Beat a Marked (Marked.yield_to) or any boss whose death opens dialogue. Dialogue pauses the tree; DangerMusic.tick returns at 'if paused' before both the _boss_wr death check and the _sting_t countdown. The boss theme keeps playing (Music is PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS) through the whole yield/recruit conversation, then once it closes the music winds down and j_victory plays 2 s later, after a calm 'Go home'/'Come with us' choice. PROBE: golem_king killed then Dialogue.say: 3 s later tier still 4, wanted 'keeper', sting not queued (tree paused). Also lieutenants: GameMap.on_enemy_died -> later(_lieutenant_choice) opens the 'What happens to me now?' dialogue right after boss_down, with the same frozen sting.
fix: Move the sting countdown and the boss-dead check above the paused early return (or call boss_ended from Marked.yield_to / Enemy._die for bosses directly); have Marked.yield_to call DangerMusic.boss_ended(m, true, false) before dl.say so the talk plays over a wound-down area song, and drop the deferred sting when the boss death already played boss_down.

title: Double victory jingle on every boss kill: boss_down (a jin_bright kit take, same 2.58 s as j_victory) then DangerMusic's j_victory 2 s later; battle commanders add j_battle_won
repro: Kill any bossy foe outside battles: Enemy._die plays boss_down (tools/ace_kits.py ALIASES boss_down->j_victory, jin_bright kit, 2.58 s), then tick() plays STING j_victory at BOSS_WIND=2 s, overlapping the tail of the first. In a battle with win_by 'boss' the captain's boss_down is followed by j_battle_won from Battle._end. MEASURED: boss_down vs j_victory waveform correlation 0.90 (both 2.58 s) - it is effectively the same jingle played twice 2 s apart.
fix: Make boss_down a non-jingle impact (big poof/thud/rumble) and keep j_victory as the one sting, or skip the DangerMusic sting when the boss's own death sound is a jingle; in battles skip boss_down when Battle._end's jingle follows.
audio_needed: optional: a heavy 'boss collapse' impact (non-musical) for boss_down

title: Dialogue blips steal sfx voices round-robin even when they are playing, cutting boss_down/j_victory/gunshots mid-sound
repro: Music.blip() takes _sfx[_next_voice % 6] without checking .playing. Kill a Marked or the meadow boss: boss_down (2.58 s) is playing when the yield dialogue opens; each line's blip advances the round-robin and will land on that voice within the first few lines, cutting the jingle dead. PROBE (tools/probe_c6_08_blip.gd): sfx('boss_down') took voice 0 (free), the very first blip('Rio') replaced it (round-robin _next_voice starts at 0): the jingle is cut by the first dialogue line.
fix: In blip(), pick a free voice first like sfx() does, and when all are busy never take one playing a j_* / boss_down / long (>1 s) stream (or give blips their own dedicated AudioStreamPlayer like _steps). Same guard for sfx()'s 'all busy' takeover: prefer the oldest short sound, never a jingle.

title: Battle commander entrance plays a bicycle horn (horn = CC0 bicycle-horn-1.wav) over the boss theme
repro: Any campaign battle with a boss: Battle (line ~466) on '<captain> takes the field!' calls sfx('horn','alert'). audio/CC0_USED.json maps horn to bicycle-horn/bicycle-horn-1.wav, so the dramatic entrance honks like a bike. campaign_convoy.gd also uses horn (a honk fits a convoy vehicle there).
fix: Give the commander entrance its own cue (war_horn / j_battle_start) via sfx('war_horn','j_battle_start'); keep 'horn' for the convoy. Import a CC0 war horn / brass blast (gangster arc: a car horn blare or siren stab) through cc0_import.py MAP.
audio_needed: war_horn (penguin) and a gangster entrance stab (e.g. war_horn_gang), short CC0 or ACE kit

title: 91 of 121 enemy kinds die with the generic 'die' sound, which is a bubble pop (rpg inventory bubble.wav / 3pops)
repro: Enemy._death_sound only knows slime/bat/golem-rock-crystal/bot/spirit/bug substrings. Every thug_* (human gangsters), soldier/archer/knight, hill_wolf/frost_wolf/ash_hound/sand_hound, lantern_moth/gloom_moth/sun_moth (moths, should be 'bug'), mirror/gilded_mirror (glass), ruin_guardian/obsidian_sentinel (stone), dune_crab, river_serpent/void_eel and every grump variant pops like a bubble (CC0_USED die = bubble.wav, bubble2.wav, 3pops). thug_cyber (the gangster summon minion, very common) plays the single 1.9 s power_off take every time.
fix: Extend _death_sound: moth->bug; wolf/hound->a yelp/whimper-free 'beast' poof; mirror/glass->glass (exists, 3 takes); guardian/sentinel/obsidian->rock_break; serpent/eel/crab->splash; thug_*/soldier/knight/archer/lt_->a cartoon 'knockout' (stars/thud) cue, all-ages. Prefer a data field (enemies.json 'die_sfx' written by the generators) over substrings. Give power_off a short 2nd/3rd take or use 'zap' for minions.
audio_needed: ko_cartoon (x3 takes, all-ages knockout), beast_poof (x3), power_off_2/_3 short takes

title: Block/guard reuse the gun's empty-click (dry_click) though a 'block' sound exists
repro: Player.take_damage 'Blocked!' perk and GameMap.attack_at when a foe's shield/GUARD stops the hit both play sfx('dry_click','thud'). In the gangster arc dry_click is also 'Click. Out of rounds', so a shielded foe sounds like your gun is empty. audio/sfx/block(.ogg,_2,_3) exists and is used only by the arcade and helper wardens.
fix: Use sfx('block','dry_click') in both places (keep dry_click for empty guns only).

title: Player spells: 9 of 12 fall back to the generic 'spell' cue; the element cues (heal, fire, ice, lightning, earth, dark, bubble) are never used by a player spell
repro: Spells.spell_sound matches words in id/element/name, but SPELLS entries carry no 'element' and the ids don't contain the words: spark, glow, haste, rain_call, crystal_shield, radiance, lull, bloom, resonance, dreamwalk -> 'spell'; only growth (nature) and warp_home (teleport) differ. So Spark, Radiance and Lull (the combat spells) all sound the same as Haste or Bloom.
fix: Add an explicit 'sfx' (or 'element') per SPELLS entry: spark->spell_lightning, radiance->spell (bright) or spell_fire, lull->a soft chime/bubble, crystal_shield->block or glass, rain_call->bubble, glow->sparkle, haste->swing_heavy/whoosh, dreamwalk/warp_home->teleport, resonance->spell_earth, bloom->spell_nature.

title: Every Gift boss move sounds the same: one 'tell' cue (single take) for all 16 move types and all Gift families; ring/zones/dash/pull impacts are silent
repro: Gift._do plays sfx('tell','spell') for every move, whatever the family (gale, cinder, iron, volt, bramble, gravity, fortune, dark_burst, mirror, shade) or type (ring, zones, dash, pull, lines, spiral, veil...). Only 'lines' adds a zap on fire. tell has one .ogg take, so a lieutenant fight is the same blip every few seconds, and the blast itself makes no sound (only the player's hurt on contact).
fix: Map Gift families to existing cues for the impact (cinder->spell_fire, gale->swing_heavy/wind, iron->rock_break/thud, volt->spell_lightning, bramble->spell_nature, gravity/dark_burst/shade->spell_dark, mirror->glass, fortune->coin) played when the move lands; keep 'tell' as the wind-up only; add tell_2/_3 takes.

title: Enemy telegraphs and abilities are silent: melee wind-up, lunge, stomp landing (shakes the screen with no sound), ranged wind-up, shield up, enrage, summon, blink, regen
repro: Read Enemy._tick_abilities: _lunge_tele/_lunge, _stomp_tele landing (map.shake(2) + damage), _range_tele (0.35 s before _shoot), shield (fx shield_up), enrage (emote+fx), _summon (toast 'It calls for help!'), _blink, regen tick: none call Music.sfx. On a 270x480 phone the tint/icon is easy to miss; the only audio in an enemy's attack is the player's hurt after it lands.
fix: Add short cues, gated by distance to the player (<170 like _shoot) and the 70 ms de-dup: lunge tele->swing_heavy (pitched down), stomp landing->thud, shield up->block, enrage->stun_2 or a growl-free 'angry' sting, summon->spell_dark/teleport, blink->teleport, ranged tele->a soft 'tell' click; keep regen silent or a very quiet heal.
audio_needed: none (existing cues cover it); optional enemy_windup cue

title: Gun takes are uneven: the starter Six-Shooter's first 'shot' take is ~5 dB quieter than its other takes and quieter than a sword swing; shot_shotgun_2 is a 0.21 s pop 7 dB under the main shotgun take; bullet hits use the fist-punch 'hit'
repro: astats RMS peak: shot -21.4 dB vs shot_2 -16.2, shot_3 -18.7; swing -14.1; shot_shotgun -14.5 vs shot_shotgun_2 -21.9 (0.21 s). Music.sfx picks a random take, so every third pistol shot sounds weak and every other Scattergun blast is a thin pop. GameMap.attack_at plays 'hit' (37-hitspunches punch pack) for gun hits too. Archers (penguin arc) fire with 'zap' since only gangster 'dark' shots use 'shot'.
fix: Level shot/shot_heavy/shot_shotgun takes to the same RMS in sfx_soften.py (or drop shot_shotgun_2 and render a full take); pass a 'bullet' flag so attack_at plays a lighter impact (thud/pop) for gun hits; give Enemy._shoot a per-kind cue (archer->bow twang, thug_flame->spell_fire).
audio_needed: bow (x2-3 takes, CC0), optional shot_shotgun_2 replacement

title: Gangster arc: a boss met while 'raid' plays inherits 'raid' as its boss song (raid is both the tier-2 fight track and in GameMap.BOSS_TRACKS)
repro: Gangster arc, fight 2+ thugs (TRACKS[2].gangsters = raid first) or have collectors near (area_track returns raid), then a bossy foe with no boss_card (Marked aside) engages. DangerMusic.boss_track_for sees cur='raid' in GameMap.BOSS_TRACKS and keeps it ('a story beat already started this fight's song'), caches it in dm_track, so boss_gang / the region boss theme never plays and the tier-4 climb makes no audible change. PROBE: gangster meadow, 5 thug_lookouts engaged -> tier 2 'raid'; president provoked -> tier 4 track 'raid' while m.boss_track('president') = boss_gang. Confirmed.
fix: In boss_track_for only reuse cur when it is a real boss theme: exclude tracks that are also TRACKS tier tracks or the raid area song (e.g. check cur != tier_track(1..3) and cur != 'raid'), or keep a separate DangerMusic.boss_song_started flag set by boss_card/boss_started.

title: Marked arrival starts the 'marked' theme without DangerMusic.boss_started, so the calm-tier area re-ask can flip it back to the area song for a moment
repro: Marked appear (marked.gd ~line 47): Music.play('marked') only; DangerMusic is still tier 0. A first threat waits one check (ENTER) before climbing, and in that check the tier-0 branch 'if tier == 0 and _area_t <= 0: mu.play(m.area_track())' can fire (about 1 in 12 arrivals), crossfading to the area song then back to 'marked' 0.25 s later. Comment there still refers to a removed '_boss_playing'.
fix: Call DangerMusic.boss_started(m, track) right after the play (as boss_card does), and update the comment; optionally have tick skip the calm re-ask while mu.wanted() is in GameMap.BOSS_TRACKS and a boss is within BOSS_R.

title: Ambience re-sets the music duck every 0.5 s: Battle's -9 dB win/loss jingle duck is undone within half a second, and night/storm ducking (-4/-5 dB) also sinks combat and boss themes
repro: Battle._end/_end_drill call _duck_music() (set_duck(was-9) for 4 s so j_battle_won/j_battle_lost cut through). Ambience._process -> _evaluate every 0.5 s calls mu.set_duck(duck) with its own 0/-4/-5 value, which differs, so the music tweens straight back up over the jingle. Separately, any night fight outdoors plays combat_light/danger/boss tracks 4 dB down (5 in a storm) under crickets/rain.
fix: Give Music a duck owner stack (e.g. set_duck(db, owner) taking the minimum of active owners, Battle's entry expiring after 4 s), and have Ambience skip its night/storm duck while DangerMusic.tier > 0 (or apply it to beds only).

title: Taking a hit sounds the same as landing one: player 'hurt' and enemy 'hit' are takes from the same punch pack
repro: audio/CC0_USED.json: hit = 37-hitspunches hit01/04/07, hurt = the same pack hit12/15/18 (both ~0.5 s, same RMS). In a scrum you can't tell by ear whether you hit or got hit; only the heartbeat under 25% HP distinguishes the player.
fix: Give 'hurt' a distinct character (a softer cartoon 'oof'-style bonk or a low thump with a short high 'ding' of lost health; all-ages, no voice gore), or layer a short UI 'damage' tick on Player.take_damage; keep 'hit' for strikes.

title: Web build: boss songs keeper, marked, boss, finargle and the battle tracks are streamed but never prefetched, so a boss fight's first seconds play over the previous song
repro: data/music_stream.json streams keeper/marked/boss/finargle/battle* (0.8-1.6 MB each). Music.PREFETCH_* lists only boss_penguin/boss_gang plus combat tiers. A mine keeper (boss_card -> keeper), a Marked arrival or a campaign battle starts the download only when the fight begins; DangerMusic keeps the current song until it arrives (seconds on a phone connection), so the boss intro card has no music change.
fix: Add keeper and marked (both arcs) and battle/battle_gang to the arc PREFETCH lists, or prefetch contextually: keeper when entering the mine, marked when the first Marked letter/flag is set, battle when a campaign is mustered (Music._fetch on those hooks).

title: Tommy Gun fires ~5.5 shots/s with 1.0 s bolt-action rifle samples (shot_rifle = mosin/sks/cz), flooding the 6 sfx voices and stealing hit/hurt/death sounds
repro: items.json tommy_gun cd 0.6 -> Player _attack_cd = 0.3*0.6 = 0.18 s. Player.gun_sound maps 'tommy' to shot_rifle (each take 1.00 s). Holding attack keeps 5-6 rifle tails alive at once; Music.sfx then takes over the oldest voice for every new hit/hurt/die/alert, and the 70 ms de-dup doesn't apply across shot_rifle/hit names. Also reload (1.4 s) every 12 shots.
fix: Give the tommy gun its own short cue (shot_smg, ~0.25 s, or trim shot_rifle to 0.3 s for it) and cap concurrent plays of one name (e.g. at most 2 voices per sound name, restarting the oldest of that name instead of stealing another sound's voice).

title: Partner abilities and borrowed Gift powers (mk_* crew) all play the generic 'spell' cue
repro: Companion.use (companion.gd ~line 177) plays sfx('spell','pickup') for every ability before the per-ability match, including 'gift:<id>' powers lent by recruited Marked (cinder, volt, gale, iron...). A few add a second cue (bee_bop stun), but a lent fire Gift and a lent gravity Gift sound identical to Nova's meow.
fix: Pick the cue per ability: for 'gift:' use the same family->cue table proposed for Gift moves (c6_08_09, e.g. Gift.sfx_for(gid)); for partner abilities add an 'sfx' to companions.json/COOLDOWN table, falling back to 'spell'.

title: Every combat-tier switch restarts its track from 0:00, so frequent skirmishes replay the same opening bars over and over (the area song also restarts from 0:00 after every fight)
repro: Music._start always plays the new stream from the start. A typical outing has many short fights: each one climbs to combat_light/_gang, falls back after GRACE 5 s, and the next fight starts the intro again; a tier drop and re-climb (3->2->3) also restarts combat_elite. Confirmed in a headless probe: summoner boss death -> combat_elite starts fresh 0.5 s later. Returning to calm, mu.play(m.area_track(), FADE_OUT) also restarts the 140 s area song from its intro after each skirmish.
fix: Remember the playback position per combat/boss track (Music: _resume[track] = player.get_playback_position() when it fades out) and resume there when the same track returns within ~60 s (start from 0 after that); for DangerMusic tier tracks and for the area song DangerMusic returns to (resume where it was when combat began); never for ONCE tracks.

title: boss_penguin is a 45 s loop (boss_gang 68 s) while other boss themes run 100-130 s; every penguin arc boss (meadow Big Grump, dark_crystal, finargle fallback, penguin commanders, cboss_*) repeats it every 45 s
repro: ffprobe: boss_penguin 45.2 s, boss_gang 68.0 s vs boss 107 s, keeper 111 s, marked 110 s, boss_wyrm 102 s. GameMap.boss_track routes big_grump, dark_crystal, grump_commander, finargle, penguin commander and all cboss_* to boss_penguin.
fix: Render a longer boss_penguin (and boss_gang) with ACE (100-120 s, A/B sections) and import with ace_import.py; or use continue_score to extend the existing score.
audio_needed: boss_penguin ~110 s render; boss_gang ~100 s render

title: The most repeated combat sound gets no pitch drift: hit/hit_2/hit_3 are exactly 0.50 s, over Music.sfx's 0.45 s 'long sound' cut-off; enemy hits are the same punch for every family
repro: Music.sfx sets pitch_scale 1.0 when st.get_length() > 0.45. All three hit takes are 0.50 s (as are hurt_3, die_3 0.60, thud 0.60), so every strike is one of three identical punches at fixed pitch, while swing (0.12 s) does drift. GameMap.attack_at plays the same 'hit' whether the foe is a slime, a golem, a bot or a thug.
fix: Base the no-drift rule on name (j_*, jingles, music-like cues) rather than length, or raise the cut-off to ~1.0 s so hits/hurts/deaths drift +-7%; optionally pick a family hit (slime->slime soft, golem/crystal->rock_break quiet, bot->zap) from the struck enemy in attack_at.

title: Collector raids never get their 'raid' theme: collectors within 220 px always count as engaged, so DangerMusic plays combat_light_gang over GameMap.area_track's 'raid'
repro: Gangster arc, heat high enough for collectors (meta collector). GameMap.area_track returns 'raid' when _collectors_near() (<220 px), but DangerMusic.is_engaged treats any collector within 220 px as engaged, so tier >= 1 and TRACKS[1].gangsters picks combat_light_gang first. The raid song is only heard by accident at tier 2 (where it is also the generic pack track).
fix: In assess, when any engaged foe has meta 'collector', use 'raid' for tiers 1-2 (keep tier 3/4 rules); give ordinary tier-2 gangster packs another track (danger or a new combat_gang) so 'raid' stays the collector theme.
audio_needed: optional: a tier-2 gangster fight track distinct from raid

title: Player knockout plays 'die' (the bubble-pop enemy death) and the combat/boss song keeps going at full level through the 1 s fade to black
repro: GameMap.player_down(reason 'hurt') -> sfx('die'), the same cue 91 enemy kinds use (CC0 bubble.wav/3pops). DangerMusic still holds tier 1-4 (foes are still engaged), so the boss theme plays on at full volume while hud.fade_out(1.0) runs, then the clinic/house song crossfades in. A knockout sounds like popping a grump, with no 'you lost' moment.
fix: Give the KO its own soft cue (faint/whoosh-down plus j_battle_lost, or a new j_faint), and in player_down fade the music out (Music.set_duck(-30) or play('', 1.0)) and reset DangerMusic (tier 0, no sting) before the fade.
audio_needed: j_faint (short, gentle defeat sting), or reuse j_battle_lost

title: Rio's 'beat' Gift is a rhythm fight with no audible beat: the 1.6 s beat and the 0.55 s 'just after' window are shown only by a ring flash, and the 'marked' theme is not in time with it; Fortune's 'count her rolls' fight has no roll sound either
repro: marked_rio (gift 'beat', rule offbeat beat 1.6 gap 0.55). Tip: 'Everything he does lands on the beat. Hit him on the beat and he parries. Hit him just after it, when the ring flashes white.' Gift._process 'offbeat' opens the window by fmod(_closed_t, beat) with no sound; the boss song is 'marked' (unrelated tempo), so ears get no beat to play to on a small phone screen. Same for the 'fortune' Gift (tip 'Count her rolls'): Gift._do 'roll' plays only the shared 'tell'; only the third roll's opening has a cue (stun).
fix: In the 'offbeat' branch play a soft tick on each beat (Music.sfx('tell') or a new 'beat_tick', distance-gated) and a brighter cue when the open window starts (e.g. 'stun' pitched up), only while within ~150 px; optionally set beat to match the marked track's tempo. For 'roll' moves play a dice/coin rattle (coin exists; add dice_roll) so the count is audible.
audio_needed: beat_tick (short wood-block/drum tick, 2 pitches); dice_roll (x2-3 takes)

title: Poison/burn/chill damage ticks on the player are silent (only a green number), and applying a status makes no sound
repro: Player._process: GameState.status_tick(delta) > 0 -> hp drops, _flash, damage_number; no Music.sfx. GameState.status_apply (enemy lunges/shots with 'inflicts') is silent too, so a poisoned player can lose a chunk of health with no audio cue.
fix: On status_apply play a short per-status cue once (poison->slime soft, burn->spell_fire short, chill/slow->spell_ice short); on each tick a very quiet tick (e.g. 'hurt' at -10 dB with pitch up, or a new status_tick), rate-limited to one per second.

title: Ally hits are mostly silent: the pup's bite plays no bite/hit sound (a bark 35% of the time), companion strikes too
repro: Pet._bite: e.hit(...) with only a 35% 'bark'; the 'bite' cue (audio/sfx/bite, used by fishing) is never played for the pup's attack. Companion.gd ~267 (meow ring hits) calls e.hit with no impact cue. Bots zap and helpers have their own cues, so the pup and partner are the odd ones out.
fix: Pet._bite: sfx('bite','hit') when landed (distance-gated, quieter than player hits, e.g. a GROUP_DB entry 'bite': -4); companion hits: a soft 'hit' at reduced volume or the ability's own cue.
